assumptions.statement: The repository provisional SITE_BOUNDARY and KEY_AREA polygons are used only for generation, visual review, and intake checks.
assumptions.impact: All area-sensitive geometry, metrics, drawings, and diagrams must be regenerated when official polygons arrive.
assumptions.trigger: Organizer-issued or rights-cleared official GIS/CAD/PDF boundary package.

assumptions.statement: Official regulatory controls, parcel boundaries, road redlines, heritage controls, municipal utilities, and flood conditions are unavailable.
assumptions.impact: FAR, height, setbacks, engineering alignments, and parcel-level retain-renovate-demolish decisions remain unknown.

assumptions.statement: Heat exposure outcomes require fixed sensors, mobile transects, weather normalization, and calibrated microclimate modelling.
assumptions.impact: Shade is a design target; heat reduction is not claimed as measured performance.
assumptions.trigger: At least one hot-season baseline and model calibration.

assumptions.statement: Rainwater retention requires design-storm, soil, groundwater, catchment, pipe-capacity, and maintenance data.
assumptions.impact: Rain gardens and the rainwater plaza are spatial prototypes, not certified drainage infrastructure.
assumptions.trigger: Professional sponge-city and municipal drainage model.

assumptions.statement: Biodiversity connectivity requires seasonally repeated species and habitat surveys.
assumptions.impact: Green continuity is geometric; ecological function remains to be validated.

assumptions.statement: Building energy coordination needs rights-cleared meter data, floor area, use schedules, and retrofit baselines.
assumptions.impact: No energy-saving percentage or capacity commitment is made.
assumptions.trigger: Owner-authorized energy audit and metering protocol.

assumptions.statement: Older-adult and child accessibility needs entrance, crossing, gradient, curb-ramp, lighting, seating, and destination audits.
assumptions.impact: Six inclusive node types are proposed; a coverage ratio remains unknown.
assumptions.trigger: Barrier-free route survey with users and professional review.

assumptions.statement: AI recommendations use aggregated or consented data and remain explainable and subject to human review.
assumptions.impact: No facial recognition, individual tracking, or automatic planning/maintenance decision is proposed.
assumptions.trigger: Scenario-specific data protection, procurement, security, and operating approvals.
